# See exactly what changed in a vendor's terms.

> Paste a vendor's terms, privacy policy, or subprocessor page. Come back later, paste it again, and get a section-by-section diff of what changed. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
